backend/main.mo: Defines core actor types and state for users, providers, documents, jobs, and MPesa config with authorization and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing the requirement to regenerate the Genz App logo with metadata and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling routing, authentication flow, role onboarding, and page rendering via state-driven navigation.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, support drawer, and page content container.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading state and react-query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Renders a role selection UI and submits the chosen user role via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with copyright, support link, and caffeine.ai attribution using UTM parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with Genz App logo, role‑based navigation, support link, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Displays animated client and provider statistics with fallback loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Shows a grid of hardcoded client testimonials with ratings and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides inputs for address and coordinates with optional browser geolocation autofill.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple chat UI allowing sending and refreshing messages with a provider.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Handles M-Pesa payment flow including phone validation, simulated STK push, and polling.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Displays a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options.
Renders a featured providers grid using demo data with avatars, verification badges, and basic provider details.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Displays a provider avatar with optional image and fallback initials, supporting size variants.
Shows a clickable provider card with avatar, verification status, location, rate, category, and average rating.
Displays a dialog showing a quick provider preview with avatar, verification, engagement status, and basic details.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Presents a card explaining and charging a connection fee to unlock a provider’s contact details.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Interactive 1–5 star rating input supporting readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Provides a drawer with phone and email support contact details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Animates a number counting up when the element becomes visible using an IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider wrapping Dfinity AuthClient for login, logout, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user, provider, and search-related backend data via an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom color variables and themed components including a styled landing page background.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with icons and helpers to fetch categories and human-readable business type labels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Back-office page for reviewing and updating provider verification status with dialogs and status badges.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays a searchable grid of service categories and navigates to results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Shows providers on a map or an unavailable notice and lists providers with navigation to details.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Lists the user’s jobs with status, allows cancellation or completion with rating, and handles job actions.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Shows provider details, verification, ratings, chat, and unlock/hire flows including Mpesa payment handling.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists and searches providers in a category with preview and navigation to detail or map view.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page UI with hero section, login trigger, feature sections, and smooth-scroll navigation.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to create or update their profile, upload images, set business info, and manage location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: React page for providers to view verification status and upload academic and conduct documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Utility functions for computing a 10% connection fee from a rate and formatting KES currency.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, supporting hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, shadows, and plugin usage for styling.
project_state.json: JSON file capturing the project's current state, requirements, issues, and architectural notes for the Genz App.
